title: Count down
prompt: The robot counts down before launch. Return an array counting down from n to 1, like [3, 2, 1]. For 0, return an empty array. Use a while loop.
hints: Keep a counter starting at n and stop when it reaches 0.

docs.name: while condition:
docs.what: Repeats the indented lines below it as long as the condition stays true.

docs.name: list.append(value)
docs.what: Adds value to the end of the array. Returns nothing.

solution:
func solve(n):
	var result = []
	var i = n
	while i > 0:
		result.append(i)
		i -= 1
	return result
